title: The only rangoli nobody steps on.
format: static, 1 slide, 1080x1440 (3:4); the owner's clean photo plate (no eyebrow, seal, bracket or wordmark)
caption:
Dhanteras asks for something new and something metal. Rhodium is a metal. We checked.

Every house draws its rangoli at the door before the first guest, and by Bhai Dooj it has been walked into the doormat. This one goes on the wrist: aqua, pink and pale yellow stones, each in its own halo, adjustable from 15 to 19 cm. Prism Rivière Bracelet, ₹2,399.

Today's mangal: Kannada, ಮಂಗಳ.

[ prism rivière bracelet · rhodium plated · no sweeping required ]
alt_text: A still life: a rhodium plated bracelet of cushion-cut aqua, pink and pale yellow stones, each ringed with tiny clear stones, laid straight across three stripes of matching coloured powder like a rangoli on cream. Text: The only rangoli nobody steps on. Mangal, ಮಂಗಳ.

gate_owner_plate.status: OPEN. Hard gate: nothing posts until the owner signs ONE of two built tiles, A (the plate) or B (the cut-out). Run it by Mon 2 Nov, together with gate_ai_label.

Both are built, checked and exported; the Kannada gate then picks the script or -noscript twin of whichever is signed.
gate_owner_plate.what_to_judge: At native resolution the plate's halos are wider than the real piece's: about 2-3 rows of pavé in a pillowed outline, against the listing's tight halo with a polished rim. The plate's links sit apart with a bare connecting bar showing; the real links butt together. The plate's stones read as soft cushions, the listing's as squarer with clipped corners. Colours, their repeating order, the four claws and the cool rhodium white all match. That puts the plate close to never-list 23 ('invented halos/pavé'). The tile no longer prints a price (grid pass r1), but its caption names and prices the piece, so it is still a sales image. A fair likeness at feed scale; the call is the owner's.
gate_owner_plate.if_signed: Post A: s01.jpg (or s01-fallback-noscript.jpg, per the Kannada gate) as built. Write the owner's name, the date and 'A' here.
gate_owner_plate.if_not_signed: Post B, already built: drawn SVG powder stripes on cream (aqua #A8DCD5 x 120-330, pink #F2B8C9 x 430-640, yellow #F3E3A0 x 740-950) with the real cut-out cutouts/prism-riviere-bracelet/x00-aa-trim.png (x00-trim, anti-aliased matte, 966x588) at 960 px wide, centred (540,867), so the box runs y 575-1159, 58 px under the turn's ink; the same type, and since the grid pass r1 no 'shown larger.' and no label line, only the plate line at 1370 when the Kannada reader signs. Files, alt text and checks are in fallback_built below. Write the owner's name, the date and 'B' here.

gate_ai_label.status: OPEN. Decide by Mon 2 Nov, together with gate_owner_plate.
gate_ai_label.question: Switch on Instagram's AI label ('AI info') for this upload, or not?
gate_ai_label.why: The plate is a photoreal generated depiction of a product for sale: the tile itself no longer prints a price (grid pass r1, rule 7), but its caption names the piece and gives ₹2,399, so the post as a whole sells it. India's 2026 IT Rules amendment on synthetically generated information makes labelling a live question, and Meta may also label it on its own from the file's metadata. The two gates depend on each other: if the owner wants 'AI info' on a post that sells the piece at ₹2,399, that is a strong case for tile B, and on Dhanteras morning there is no time to switch. Decide both by Mon 2 Nov. Still re-confirm the IT Rules requirement (the rule's text and Instagram's current upload setting) on the posting morning; do not rely on this note.
gate_ai_label.image_changes: None. Nothing on the image changes either way; the label is a setting on the upload.
gate_ai_label.applies_to: Tile A only (s01.jpg and s01-fallback-noscript.jpg use the same generated plate). Tile B contains no generated pixels: the piece is the listing photograph (Shopify image 0) with its background removed and its matte edge smoothed, on flat drawn SVG stripes. Re-ask the question for B on the posting morning if B is signed, but it is not a synthetic depiction.
gate_ai_label.record_for_P11: P11 is the other owner plate (assets/artifacts/approved-ads/ads/07-baguette-tennis-bracelet-story.jpg, Fri 20 Nov). Whatever is decided here, copy the decision and its reason into P11's post.json so both plates get the same treatment.
gate_ai_label.alt_text_rule: If this gate decides to label tile A, its alt text starts 'A generated still life:' instead of 'A still life:' (both alt_text arrays), so the screen-reader text says what the upload setting says. Tile B's alt text is unchanged either way.
